name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and manages Nginx for three sites, including static content, per-site configuration, self-signed TLS certificates, fail2ban, firewall rules, sysctl hardening, and SSH restrictions.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, enabling Redis as a service with authentication, custom runtime paths, logging, and post-processing of its generated configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a Python/FastAPI application from GitHub, including its virtual environment, dependencies, PostgreSQL database and user, environment configuration, and systemd/Uvicorn service on port 8000.
